quests.title: Letters from Home
quests.offer: {name}, wait - a moment. A courier found me with this: a letter from Master Aldous Wren, the {cclass} who taught me {clesson}. It's strange. He says he found something in Campacorentin Forest, and that if I don't hear from him by the new moon I should come looking. That was a month ago. I know we've our own road... but will you come with me?
quests.summary: Your companion's own story, chapter 1 of 5.

steps.goal: Find Master Aldous Wren's camp in Campacorentin Forest
steps.text: Master Aldous Wren's camp has been torn apart: the tent slashed, the fire kicked out, and a grey handprint daubed on a stone.

stages.name: Grey Hand Cutthroat-Chief
stages.announce: They come out of hiding as if they had been waiting. 'More of the old one's friends? Good. Fewer to hunt later.'

steps.text: Among the leader's things: Master Aldous Wren's journal, half its pages torn out.

steps.say: This is Master Aldous Wren's journal. He would never leave it behind - not willingly. There's a name in here, 'the Grey Hand', and a meeting place. {name}, I have to know what happened to him. Will you see this through with me? [I will]

quests.title: The Grey Hand
quests.offer: I've read the journal every night. The last whole page says the Grey Hand meet in Avalon Marsh, and that they want the Seal of Wren - whatever that is. Master Aldous Wren went to see for himself. Let's go and see for ourselves.
quests.summary: Your companion's own story, chapter 2 of 5.

steps.goal: Find where the Grey Hand meet in Avalon Marsh
steps.text: Ashes of a meeting fire, and the marks of a great many boots. Not long gone.

steps.goal: Defeat Sister Morwen of the Grey Hand

stages.name: Sister Morwen of the Grey Hand
stages.objective: Defeat Sister Morwen of the Grey Hand
stages.announce: A voice from the shadows: 'The student comes looking for the master. How sweet. How foolish.'

boss.name: Sister Morwen of the Grey Hand

stages.success: Sister Morwen of the Grey Hand falls.

steps.text: The lieutenant's orders name a prison, and a prisoner: Master Aldous Wren.

steps.say: Master Aldous Wren's alive! A prisoner - but alive. {name}, I could kiss you. Don't worry, I won't. We go after him, yes? [Onward]

quests.title: The Empty Cage
quests.offer: The orders said Master Aldous Wren is held in Cornwall. I've barely slept since. Please - let's go now.
quests.summary: Your companion's own story, chapter 3 of 5.

steps.goal: Find the prison of the Grey Hand in Cornwall
steps.text: An empty cage. Scratched into its bars, in Master Aldous Wren's hand: 'Not the relic. Me. They want what I know.'

stages.name: Gaoler Brannoc
stages.announce: The jailer rattles a ring of keys. 'Come for the old one? You're a week late. But you'll do instead.'

steps.text: The jailer's ledger says Master Aldous Wren was moved a week ago, further into the wild - and names who sold him out: Garrick Vane.

steps.say: Moved. Again. And Garrick Vane... Master Aldous Wren's own student, before me. I'm sorry, {name} - I'm angry, and none of it's at you. Thank you for staying. [Always]

quests.title: Old Debts
quests.offer: I know where Garrick Vane is now: Lyonesse. Master Aldous Wren trusted Garrick Vane like a son, like a daughter. I want to look Garrick Vane in the eye. Come with me?
quests.summary: Your companion's own story, chapter 4 of 5.

steps.text: Garrick Vane is waiting for you, as if they knew you would come.

stages.name: Garrick Vane
stages.announce: Garrick Vane draws, unhurried. 'The master always did like you better. Let's see why.'

steps.text: Garrick Vane falls to one knee. 'The master is in Dartmoor, with the one who leads the Grey Hand. Go, then. You were always the better student.'

steps.say: I thought beating Garrick Vane would feel like something. It just feels tired. One more road, {name}. The last one. [Let's end it]

quests.title: The Last Lesson
quests.offer: This is it. Master Aldous Wren is in Dartmoor, with the one who leads the Grey Hand. Whatever happens there... I'm glad it's you beside me, {name}.
quests.summary: Your companion's own story, chapter 5 of 5.

steps.goal: Find Master Aldous Wren in Dartmoor
steps.text: Master Aldous Wren is there - chained, grey-faced, alive. And between you and him: the one who leads the Grey Hand.

stages.name: the Grey Master
stages.announce: 'The seal of wren was never the prize. Your master's mind was. And now yours.'

steps.text: The leader of the Grey Hand falls, and the chains fall with them. Master Aldous Wren stands, slowly, and looks at {cname} for a long time.

steps.say: Master Aldous Wren says I've nothing left to learn from him. That the rest I learned from you. I don't know about that. But I know I'm not going anywhere, {name}. Not without you. [Nor I without you]
